core_obligations: Turn an element of Ext^i into a morphism P-underlined -> I^i with d^i o phi = 0 and reduce to triviality of the associated Yoneda extension (proof lines 1434-1449).
Introduce property (*) and verify it for M-underlined, the injectives I^n, P-underlined and the fibre-product term (proof lines 1451-1465).
Replace the extension by one whose terms all satisfy (*) (proof lines 1467-1473).
Apply TF(-, -) degreewise to build the module-valued functors G_j and the comparison maps, and show the resulting extension is trivial (proof lines 1474-1554).
proof_roadmap: Application of TF and the comparison (proof lines 1474-1554).
difficulty_reason: For a ring A and A-modules M and P with P of finite presentation, the lemma asserts that Ext^i_P(P-underlined, M-underlined) vanishes for i > 0 in the category of module-valued functors on Alg_A (statement lines 1424-1431). The proof is a long displayed argument: an injective resolution of M-underlined is chosen, an element of the Ext group is represented by a morphism into I^i killed by the differential, and one must show the associated Yoneda extension is trivial; the author introduces property (*) -- that TF(B, -) turns short exact sequences of B-modules into right exact sequences -- proves that all functors occurring in the extension have it, then applies the functor TF(-, -) degreewise to obtain a second Yoneda extension together with functorial B-linear comparison maps, and concludes by splitting (proof lines 1433-1554). The level is H3: the card carries a genuine multi-page construction with an invented property and a functoriality computation, not a citation.
